title: Synthesis and properties of branched alcohol alkoxylate sulfates
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40267-40278

In this study, three branched alcohol alkoxylate sulfates (C10E3S, C10E3P3S and C10P3E3S) were synthesized using a gas SO3 membrane sulfonation device.
